Notify TX manager that if transaction breaker is committed then the transaction victim must be aborted due to conflict.

detaileddescription.para:
It is achieved by adding corresponding entry (of tx_conflict_tracker type) to breaker conflict list. In case there's already such entry, then move it to the head of the list in order to optimize next invocations of this function. For example: there's two rw transaction in progress, one have read some value while the second is about to overwrite it. If the second is committed first, the first must be aborted.
0 on success, -1 on memory error.

briefdescription.para: Handle conflict when breaker transaction is prepared.

briefdescription.para: Add a statement to transaction manager's history.

detaileddescription.para:
Until unlinking or releasing the space could internally contain wrong tuples and must be cleaned through memtx_tx_tuple_clarify call. With that clarifying the statement will be visible to current transaction, but invisible to all others. Follows signature of
memtx_space_replace_all_keys .
stmt
current statement.
old_tuple
the tuple that should be removed (can be NULL).
new_tuple
the tuple that should be inserted (can be NULL).
mode
dup_replace_mode, used only if new_tuple is not NULL and old_tuple is NULL, and only for the primary key.
result
- old or replaced tuple.
0 on success, -1 on error (diag is set).

briefdescription.para: Rollback (undo) a statement from transaction manager's history.

detaileddescription.para: It's just make the statement invisible to all. Prepared statements could be also removed, but for consistency all latter prepared statement must be also rolled back.

briefdescription.para: Prepare statement in history for further commit.

detaileddescription.para: Prepared statements are still invisible for read-only transactions but are visible to all read-write transactions. Prepared and in-progress transactions use the same links for creating chains of stories in history. The difference is that the order of prepared transactions is fixed while in-progress transactions are added to the end of list in any order. Thus to switch to prepared we have to reorder story in such a way that current story will be between earlier prepared stories and in-progress stories. That's what this function does.

briefdescription.para: Commit statement in history.

detaileddescription.para: Make the statement's changes permanent. It becomes visible to all.
